versions.changelog: Declares what the skill reads, executes and sends. Adds an explicit note that sleep details go to api.whenpeak.com, nothing is stored, and any suggestion to connect Apple Health comes with a data-sharing note.

Adds handling for dated events and body-clock shifts: gives the single-day prediction and points multi-night planning to whenpeak.com rather than attempting it from one self-reported night. Broadens the description to match those questions.
